keys.description: ±0.003 mm on a milled block is below normal machining capability
keys.rule: ISO 2768-1 general tolerance, fine class 6-30 mm = +/-0.1 mm; +/-0.003 mm is far below that and below normal milling (needs grinding/lapping). https://www.xometry.com/resources/certifications/iso-2768 , read 2026-10-13
